clue.text: Mushrooms initially served with filling extras

indicators.note: initially says only the opening letter of the word served is used
filling says the abbreviation for with goes inside the cricket term

parts.note: no-balls are extras in cricket, runs awarded for illegal deliveries

explanation.surface: A cook serves a mushroom dish with a filling, plus a few extras on the side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mushrooms' looks like a food noun but is a verb. NO-BALLS are cricket extras, penalty runs given for an illegal delivery.
explanation.definitionFit: Both verbs mean grows rapidly and uncontrollably, the way a rolling ball of snow keeps getting bigger.

clue.text: Outer part of some bud?

indicators.note: Outer part of says only the first and last letters of some are kept

parts.note: bud, short for buddy, is a pal

explanation.surface: A botanical question about what covers the outside of a bud.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: SE, the outside of 'some', plus PAL for 'bud'.
explanation.definitionFit: Botanically these are the leaf-like segments of the calyx enclosing an unopened flower.

clue.text: US resort where the men network and party

parts.note: OR, other ranks, are the ordinary soldiers as opposed to officers
LAN is a local area network
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A holiday town in America where the blokes go to make contacts and celebrate.
explanation.definitionFit: This Florida city is a holiday destination famous for its theme parks.

clue.text: Polish sent up by fresh sequel to parody

indicators.note: in a down entry, sent up means the word is written bottom to top

parts.note: to rub something is to polish it

indicators.note: fresh says the letters of sequel are made new, rearranged

explanation.surface: A writer polishes a new sequel meant to send up the original.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent up' reverses RUB to BUR, and 'fresh' turns SEQUEL into LESQUE.
explanation.definitionFit: Both nouns name a mocking imitation that exaggerates a serious work for comic effect.

clue.text: One could fire unexpectedly at large girl in fleece

parts.note: an escaped animal at large is on the loose

indicators.note: in says the girl's name sits inside the word for swindle

parts.note: to fleece someone is to con them
Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl wrapped in a fleece might fire a weapon at any moment.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a gun, which is the literal sense of the definition; the idiom is an unpredictable person.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally an unsecured cannon on deck; figuratively someone unpredictable who may cause damage without warning.

clue.text: Dry function

definitions.meaning: a dry wine is described with the French word for dry
the secant is a trigonometric function, abbreviated to three letters

explanation.definitionFit: It is both the French-derived term for dry wine and the short name of the secant in trigonometry.

clue.text: Selector's mission briefly an issue

indicators.note: briefly says the phrase is cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: a selector's job is to pick, so the mission is 'to pick'

explanation.surface: Whether the team selector has done the job is a talking point.
explanation.definitionFit: An issue under discussion is a subject or theme.

clue.text: Top of barrel frozen, not bottom

parts.note: a tun is a large barrel or cask

indicators.note: in a down entry, not bottom drops the lowest letter of the word

parts.note: frozen means icy

explanation.surface: The upper end of a barrel has iced over, but not the base.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Top of barrel' reads as one phrase, but 'Top' alone is the definition, a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A loose garment covering the upper body is a kind of top.

clue.text: Italian scorer returning home in charge of trophy

indicators.note: returning says the assembled letters are read back the other way

parts.note: at home means in
a cup is a trophy

explanation.surface: An Italian goalscorer comes home to take charge of a trophy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scorer' suggests football, but here it is a writer of musical scores.
explanation.definitionFit: The composer of La Bohème and Tosca wrote operatic scores, so he is a scorer.

clue.text: One worked with dip in range over three miles?

indicators.note: in a down entry, over puts the first piece above the second

parts.note: a col is a dip or pass between peaks in a mountain range
a league is an old measure of about three miles

explanation.surface: Someone works out a hike over a mountain pass of three miles.
explanation.definitionFit: A coworker is a person one worked with, a fellow member of a profession or staff.

clue.text: Pair consuming beer, two shakes and Italian port

indicators.note: consuming says the pair's letters swallow the others

parts.note: ale is beer
in two shakes means in a moment, a mo

explanation.surface: A couple downs beer and a couple of milkshakes at a harbour in Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'two shakes' looks like drinks; it is the idiom 'in two shakes', a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: This Sicilian capital is a seaport city in Italy.

clue.text: As funnel often about, oilcan abandoned

parts.note: C, for circa, means about

indicators.note: abandoned suggests the letters of oilcan are let loose, rearranged

explanation.surface: An oilcan lies discarded near a funnel.
explanation.definitionFit: A funnel usually tapers to a point, so it is typically cone-shaped.

clue.text: Train on line to advance suddenly

definitions.meaning: a horse is exercised in circles on a long rein, the training method and the rein sharing one name
to thrust forward abruptly, as a fencer does

explanation.surface: Someone trains on the railway line before lurching forward.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a long rein for exercising a horse and a sudden forward thrust.

clue.text: Telling vet if fee at first completely outrageous

indicators.note: outrageous says the letters are thrown wildly into a new order
at first says only the opening letter of completely is taken

explanation.surface: A vet's fee is completely outrageous, and that says something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outrageous' rearranges VET, IF, FEE and C into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A telling point is one that has a strong effect, a forceful or impressive one.

clue.text: Putting out of ashes perhaps, one having been used for nothing?

definitions.text: Putting out of ashes perhaps, one having been used for nothing?

indicators.note: having been used for says one letter stands where another was

parts.note: planting out trees, ash being one example, is afforestation
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A puzzle about planting out ash trees, with one thing standing in for nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one having been used for nothing' puts I in place of O (nothing) in FORESTATION; the whole clue also hints at firefighters putting out what leaves ashes.
explanation.definitionFit: A base for firefighters, whose work is putting out blazes that leave ashes.

clue.text: I don't like that black pair of spectacles

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
OO looks like a pair of round lenses

explanation.surface: Someone dislikes a pair of black-framed glasses.
explanation.definitionFit: A jeer of disapproval expresses dislike, as an audience does at a bad show.

clue.text: Extra mouthpiece musician's brought

parts.note: a bit is the metal mouthpiece of a horse's bridle
a player is a musician

explanation.surface: A musician brings along a spare mouthpiece for the instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extra' looks like an adjective, but it is a film extra.
explanation.definitionFit: A film extra is an actor with a tiny, minor part in a production.

clue.text: Motorbike prevailing without power greatly increasing

parts.note: a quad is a four-wheeled motorbike

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the word for prevailing wraps round the letter for power

parts.note: the ruling view is the prevailing one

explanation.surface: A quad bike's prevailing advantage, minus power, grows enormously.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it means outside, wrapping RULING round P.
explanation.definitionFit: Multiplying by four is a big rise, so the phrase fits loosely as a large increase.

clue.text: Using bike in gym, Auntie's boss coming across exhausted

parts.note: PE, physical education, is school gym

indicators.note: coming across says the boss's letters straddle the word for exhausted

parts.note: Auntie is the BBC, whose head is the Director General, DG
all in means exhausted

explanation.surface: A BBC chief, worn out, crosses the gym on an exercise bike.
explanation.walkthrough: Auntie is a nickname for the BBC, Britain's public broadcaster; its boss is the Director General.
explanation.definitionFit: Working the pedals is what a cyclist does when riding.

clue.text: Sweet daughter has got scent in vain

indicators.note: has got says the sweet and daughter together hold the scent inside them

parts.note: a toffee is a sweet
the nose of a wine is its scent

explanation.surface: A girl has bought a sweet perfume and is rather pleased with herself.
explanation.definitionFit: Snooty, conceited people are said to look down their noses, so the term means haughty.

clue.text: On reflection, some laptop's sufficient for a particular person

indicators.note: On reflection says the hidden letters are read backwards
some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Thinking it over, a laptop will do for one fastidious buyer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' picks TOPSSUF from inside 'laptop's sufficient' and 'On reflection' reads it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Particular means fussy, so a particular person is a fusser over details.

clue.text: Girl no longer new in the neighbourhood

indicators.note: no longer says the letter for new is dropped

parts.note: a zone is an area or neighbourhood

explanation.surface: A girl is no longer the new arrival on the block.
explanation.definitionFit: Zoe is a girl's given name, from the Greek for life.

clue.text: Unknown surgeon a very minor celebrity

parts.note: Z is an algebraic unknown
Joseph Lister was the surgeon who pioneered antiseptic surgery

explanation.surface: An unknown surgeon is barely famous.
explanation.definitionFit: Celebrities are graded A-list downwards, so the last letter marks the most minor.

clue.text: Old province of Asia, until broken up

indicators.note: broken up says the letters of the two words are split and reassembled

explanation.surface: An old Asian province until the empire fragmented.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of Asia' suggests the province is Asian; it was Roman, in Iberia.
explanation.definitionFit: This Roman province covered most of modern Portugal.

clue.text: New hit on the way, following earlier couple?

indicators.note: New says the letters of hit are made over in a fresh order

parts.note: RD, road, is a way

explanation.surface: A new hit song is on the road, after an earlier pair.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming after the first two in a sequence makes something number three in order.

clue.text: Water flowing round among coins once thrown in Trevi?

indicators.note: among says the round letter sits within the coins

parts.note: tourists threw lire, the pre-euro Italian currency, into Rome's Trevi Fountain
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: Water swirls round coins tossed into the Trevi Fountain.
explanation.walkthrough: The Trevi suggests Rome, but the answer is a French river.
explanation.definitionFit: A river is flowing water; this is France's longest.

clue.text: A host of terms: clever, but oddly overlooked

indicators.note: oddly overlooked says the odd-numbered letters are passed over, leaving the even ones

explanation.surface: A host of clever terms, though some are oddly ignored.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A host of' looks like 'many'; 'A host' is the definition and 'of' a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A master of ceremonies hosts an event; the word spells out the initials MC.

clue.text: Turn to young pro United very quietly provided within two years

indicators.note: within says the other pieces go inside the pair of years

parts.note: Y is the abbreviation for year, so two years give two of them
PP, pianissimo, means very quietly in music
if means provided

explanation.surface: Within two years, a young pro at United becomes very quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: To gentrify or make something suit young urban professionals is to convert it to their taste.

clue.text: Pulled up part of spring vegetable

indicators.note: in a down entry, pulled up means the word reads from the bottom

parts.note: May is a month in spring

explanation.surface: A vegetable dug up in spring.
explanation.definitionFit: A starchy tuber eaten as a vegetable, much like a sweet potato.

clue.text: "Absurd" tag one associated with the Listener

parts.note: an ID tag identifies someone
I is the Roman numeral for one
otic means relating to the ear, the organ that listens

explanation.surface: A tag calling something absurd is linked to the Listener crossword.
explanation.walkthrough: The Listener is a famously hard crossword; here it is just the ear.
explanation.definitionFit: Foolish and absurd are near-synonyms for something senseless.

clue.text: Was dressing down deserved?

definitions.meaning: an old verb sense, to scold or reprimand
earned or merited, as a performance deserving a high score

explanation.definitionFit: It means both scolded, from an old verb, and judged worthy of a ranking.

clue.text: Collection people are getting on retirement — in euros at first

parts.note: men are people
people getting on in years age

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of each of the three words

explanation.surface: People getting old put their retirement savings in euros early on.
explanation.definitionFit: A collection of wild animals kept for display; figuratively any assorted group.
